records.context: ``ops_read_distance_weight`` (item 988, alpha). ``'off'`` keeps the weights above. ``'decay'`` multiplies each read's weight by its distance term, and ``'distance_only'`` uses the distance term alone. The distance term is 1 up to ``interior_px`` and ``exp(-(g - interior_px) / decay_px)`` beyond it, at least ``min_weight``. A one-read guide then needs its quality times its distance term to reach ``single_read_quality``.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.vote_mapped_reads#19
records.source: ``ops_read_distance_weight`` (item 988, alpha). ``'off'`` keeps the weights above. ``'decay'`` multiplies each read's weight by its distance term, and ``'distance_only'`` uses the distance term alone. The distance term is 1 up to ``interior_px`` and ``exp(-(g - interior_px) / decay_px)`` beyond it, at least ``min_weight``. A one-read guide then needs its quality times its distance term to reach ``single_read_quality``.
records.translation: ``ops_read_distance_weight`` (item 988, alpha). ``'off'`` conserve les poids ci-dessus. ``'decay'`` multiplie le poids de chaque lecture par son terme de distance, et ``'distance_only'`` utilise le terme de distance seul. Le terme de distance vaut 1 jusqu’à ``interior_px`` et ``exp(-(g - interior_px) / decay_px)`` au-delà, au moins ``min_weight``. Un guide à lecture unique a alors besoin que sa qualité multipliée par son terme de distance atteigne ``single_read_quality``.
